scripts.text:
[Esseray]
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
初心者世界的一位傳奇人物為了在克魔島做某事而失蹤了。
你應該去找找他。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能指引你
走上正確的道路...

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
You're looking good.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
哦？你是初心者協會的一員嗎？
看起來很不錯啊。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
You look full of energy...
You seem strong enough to endure the test.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
你看起來精力充沛...
似乎有足夠的實力來承受考驗。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
我知道一種變強的方法。你願意嘗試一下嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'm okay now.
scripts.translation: 不，我現在這樣就很好。

scripts.text: I want to be stronger!
scripts.translation: 我想變強！

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
Live a normal life then.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
如果你滿足於平庸，我幫不了你。
那就過普通的生活吧。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
Good!
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
很好！
初心者世界的一位傳奇人物為了在克魔島做某事而失蹤了。
你應該去找找他。

scripts.text:
[Esseray]
He can guide you along
the correct path...
scripts.translation:
[艾瑟雷]
他能指引你
走上正確的道路...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Sh --------- !!
Be quiet please.
You'll scare the fish.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
噓 --------- ！！
請安靜一點。
你會把魚嚇跑的。

scripts.text: Hmm... 'scuse me...

[Fishing Novice]
Aaaaaaak!!
What are you doing?
I told you be quiet!
They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
啊啊啊啊！！
你在幹什麼？
我讓你安靜點！
魚都被你的噪音嚇跑了~

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
(-- sh--aking --)
Who... are you?
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
(-- 顫抖 --)
你... 是誰？
為什麼要打擾我釣魚？

scripts.text: I have a delivery from Esseray...
scripts.translation: 我有艾瑟雷的快遞...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What? Esseray? Esseray?
Hmm! I know him...
Esseray... Esseray... hmm.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什麼？艾瑟雷？艾瑟雷？
嗯！我認識他...
艾瑟雷... 艾瑟雷... 嗯。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Ahhhh --- !! ----- Ahhhh ---!!
Got it! --- Got it!
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
Esseray, right? Wrong?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
啊哈哈 --- ！！ ----- 啊哈哈 --- ！！
知道了！ --- 知道了！
^0000FF艾爾戴巴初心者協會的成員。^000000
是艾瑟雷吧？沒錯吧？

scripts.text: No he isn't
scripts.translation: 不，不是他

scripts.text: Yes, right
scripts.translation: 是的，沒錯

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
呼呼~ 我的直覺還活著呢...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
So what do you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
所以，你想從我這裡得到什麼？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What?! He isn't?
Then where is Esseray from?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什麼？！不是他？
那艾瑟雷是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
What -------- !!
That isn't important, right?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
什 -------- 麼！！
這並不重要，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Then -------- !!
Why did you come here?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
那 -------- 麼！！
你為什麼要來這裡？

scripts.text: - You explain why you're here. -
scripts.translation: - 解釋一下你在這裡的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
嗯... 這是一個既簡單又困難的問題。

scripts.text: - You hear a voice complaining about something. -
scripts.translation: - 你聽到有人在抱怨什麼。 -

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
艾瑟雷！那個該死的混蛋，竟然毀了我的假期...

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Haaaaa~
My poor life~
Ahhh~ so many problems.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
哈啊~
我可憐的生活~
啊~ 問題真多。

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Too ~ hard. Hey, little kid!
What's your name?
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
太~難了。嘿，小孩子！
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: {0}, how about you?

[Nodor]
My name is Nodor! Nodor.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我叫諾多爾！諾多爾。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿！我從你的臉上就能看出你在想什麼~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
Condor and Odor...
Don't try to fool me.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
因為我的名字叫諾多爾，我這一輩子都在被取笑。
禿鷹和臭味...
別想騙我。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Whatever the reason is... you are here!
Let's get together to go further.
Come again after a while~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
不管原因是什麼... 你在這裡！
讓我們聚在一起，走得更遠。
過一會兒再來找我~

scripts.text: - Talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 再和他談談。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm ----- !!
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -
scripts.translation: - 諾多爾用懷疑的眼神看著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你不知道^0000FF超級初心者^000000很厲害嗎？

scripts.text: - Nodor asks with confidence. -
scripts.translation: - 諾多爾自信地問道。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice~
Do you know who I am?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿！超級初心者~
你知道我是誰嗎？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?!
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heh...
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呵...
你還挺有膽量的嘛？

scripts.text: - This guy is a weirdo. -
scripts.translation: - 這傢伙是個怪人。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice ~
I will make you stronger!
So will you believe what I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿！超級初心者~
我會讓你變強的！
所以，你願意相信我說的話嗎？

scripts.text: I won't follow you.
scripts.translation: 我不會聽你的。

scripts.text: Why not? kehehe~
scripts.translation: 為什麼？嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
I'd love to do nothing too.
Just let me fish if you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
拒絕？難道你不想變強嗎？
我也很樂意什麼都不做。
如果你想走的話，就讓我釣魚吧。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Emmhmm~ Do I sound harsh?
Hmm, I can't help using such words.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯哼~ 我聽起來很嚴厲嗎？
嗯，我沒辦法不這麼說話。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't sweat it.
It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別在意。
教你變強對我來說不是問題。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Great~!
What is your issue?
You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
太好了~！
你的問題是什麼？
你不知道怎麼變強，對吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I can't get stronger.
scripts.translation: 是的，我無法變強。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhmmm ~!
There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
tell you how.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯哼~！
有一種方法...
雖然很危險，但我可以告訴你怎麼做。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
How about it?
Are you willing to do this?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我只提一個條件。你不問任何問題，並且照我說的做！
怎麼樣？
你願意這樣做嗎？

scripts.text: No, I will not!
scripts.translation: 不，我不願意！

scripts.text: Let's do this!
scripts.translation: 讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
變強是生存的唯一方式！
你想永遠當個弱者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I will give you a tip.
You can't always be right.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我給你一個建議。
你不能總是對的。
有時候你需要放下自尊，聽聽別人的意見。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
All right --------- !!
Your passion will make you stronger.
You calm?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
很好！！
你的熱情會讓你變得更強。
你冷靜下來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What I want you to do is...
Hunt 1,000 monsters.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我要你做的是...
獵殺1000只魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Do you know what this is for?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你知道這是為了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你知道^FF0000{0}^000000這種魔物，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hunt 1,000!
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
獵殺1000只！
別說不行！
我知道數量很多，但它們很弱！

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Huh huh~!
Rembember, no questions!
Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呵呵~！
記住，不許提問！
沒獵殺完1000只之前別回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Nodor!

[Nodor]
Oh my god!
So frightened... let me see?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
天哪！
嚇死我了...讓我看看？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey! Super Novice!
Didn't I say to hunt 1,000?
Don't come back until you have.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿！超級初心者！
我是不是說過要獵殺1000只？
沒完成之前別回來。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you hunted all 1,000 already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你已經獵殺完1000只了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你比我想像的更強。
總之，我讓你獵殺的是什麼魔物？

scripts.text: Poring
scripts.translation: 波利

scripts.text: Lunatic
scripts.translation: 瘋兔

scripts.text: Fabre
scripts.translation: 綠棉蟲

scripts.text: Picky
scripts.translation: 小雞

scripts.text: Baphomet
scripts.translation: 巴風特

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿嘿？你真的能獨自獵殺巴風特？
別撒謊！！我要揍你！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't tell a lie!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別撒謊！
我沒讓你獵殺這個！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
keheheheheheh~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You annoyed me so I made you do this task...
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你惹惱我了，所以我才讓你做這個任務...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Wow! You actually hunted all 1,000?
I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哇！你真的獵殺完1000只了？
看來我不能質疑你變強的熱情了。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Okay! So far so good.
I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
好！目前為止表現不錯。
我會告訴你如何克服力量上的不足。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh! You already came here?
Didn't you say you have something to handle?
You have enough passion but...
you need to learn patience.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哦！你已經來了？
你不是說有事要處理嗎？
你有足夠的熱情，但是...
你需要學會耐心。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hhhhhhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呼~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh sorry! Sorry!
I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
啊，抱歉！抱歉！
我很久以前收到了一封來自我哥哥的信，你要不要讀一下，順便了解一下情況？

scripts.text: Yes, I will
scripts.translation: 好，我讀

scripts.text: No, I won't
scripts.translation: 不，我不讀

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You should read more!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你應該多讀點書！

scripts.text: - He throws a bundled letter at you. -
scripts.translation: - 他把一封捆好的信扔給了你。 -

scripts.text:
Dear Bro. Nodor,
 
Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.
scripts.translation:
親愛的哥哥諾多爾：
 
嘿，哥哥，我是你弟弟努多爾。你最近怎麼樣？我寫這封信的原因是...
我需要錢買食物。你有很多錢，所以幫幫我。

scripts.text:
If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
- The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
如果你不...記得上次你%$&*@*&%$...
- 信被揉皺了，你讀不下去了。 -
我還在修瓦魯茲巴魯德。
~ 努多爾

scripts.text: - You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -
scripts.translation: - 讀完這封信，你感到一陣不安。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hu~u~
Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
It's got to be my fame... T_T
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
呼~
嗯，我只有一個哥哥，他總是向我要錢。
一定是因為我的名聲... T_T

scripts.text: - Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -
scripts.translation: - 現在你真的感到不安了。 -

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey- Super Novice {0}!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿- 超級初心者{0}！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你可以給點錢給我哥哥。他在飛空艇上。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Have you visited already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你去過了嗎？

scripts.text: How much money should I give?
scripts.translation: 我該給多少錢？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
Give him a little, ya~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哦，你還沒去那裡？
給他一點就好，呀~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
100,000 zeny is okay~
1,000,000 zeny is okay~
10,000,000 zeny is okay~
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
100,000 Zeny 就好~
1,000,000 Zeny 也好~
10,000,000 Zeny 也可以~

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hey, have you gone there?
I got another message from my bro.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嘿，你去那裡了嗎？
我又收到我哥哥的訊息了。

scripts.text:
Bro, someone gave me...
{0} Zeny.
You do care about me...
~ Nudor
scripts.translation:
哥哥，有人給了我...
{0} Zeny。
你果然關心我...
~ 努多爾

scripts.text: He seemed so hungry...
scripts.translation: 他看起來好餓...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
By the way...
{0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
話說回來...
以我的明星身份，{0} Zeny 也太少了吧，你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Anyway~
{0} Zeny...
Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
總之~
{0} Zeny...
你不覺得給得太少了嗎？我的名聲要受損了。

scripts.text: Hey...

[Nodor]
Wow, you've got my point already?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哇哦，你一下子就懂我的意思了？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I think you are right.
This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我覺得你說得對。
這個考驗的是你喚起他人同情心的能力。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我是說你的消費習慣和直覺...
哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Hey, that's not my...
scripts.translation: 嘿，那不是我的...

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Hmm? Ah...
I almost forgot to tell
you how to exceed your limit,
didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
嗯？啊...
我差點忘了告訴你
如何突破極限，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
咳-咳！我可不是打發時間才派你去的！！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
What the? --- ah? --- !!

[Nodor]
Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
We... have to run...!!!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
小心！！一群巨石怪在追我們！
我們...必須跑...！！！

scripts.text: What?!
scripts.translation: 什麼？！

scripts.text: Um?
scripts.translation: 嗯？

scripts.text:
- You look around, and -
- there is nothing behind you. -
- When you are about to doubt... -
scripts.translation:
- 你環顧四周，- 
- 身後什麼都沒有。- 
- 正當你開始懷疑時...-

scripts.text:
- You ask Nodor once -
- again in your fright... -
scripts.translation:
- 你驚恐地再次- 
- 詢問諾多爾...-

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
I can't make you stronger until you use those points.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你還有未使用的技能點。
在你用完這些點數之前，我無法讓你變強。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Puhahahahahahahahahahah!!
Good! You scared yet?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
噗哈哈哈哈哈！！
很好！你被嚇到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Sorry for scaring you!
I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
抱歉嚇到你了！
我認為我們作為初心者的職責和使命，就是讓每一天都充滿歡樂。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
Feel your body lighter than before...?
Or more powerful?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
那麼，你有沒有感覺到什麼變化？
感覺身體比之前更輕盈...？
或者更強大？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Oh--- My--- (tut,tut,tut)!!

[Nodor]
Mr. Sieu Ngu --
Not to be mean, but
you are a little dull...
Don't you feel different now?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
西烏·恩古先生 --
不是故意說難聽的，
但你有點遲鈍啊...
現在難道沒有感覺到不同嗎？

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text: I got it!
scripts.translation: 我明白了！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You already exceeded your limit.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
啊--- 對，你確實遲鈍，不是嗎？
你已經突破了極限。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
You can be stronger than before.
Wasn't it your dream?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
你現在可以變得比之前更強了。
這不是你的夢想嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Ok~!
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
That's it!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
好~！
現在去闖蕩世界吧，作為初心者，享受你自由快樂的生活！
就是這樣！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
(Pouting) ------------- !!
So you're finally back.

[Nodor]
To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
為了慶祝這位新的初心者同志，我準備了一些裝備送給你 --

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
And don't say I didn't warn you either.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別忘了確認你的^FF0000背包^000000裡有足夠的空間來接收這些物品。
而且別到時候說我沒提醒你。

scripts.text: Yes, let me check my inventory.
scripts.translation: 好的，讓我檢查一下背包。

scripts.text: I'm good, show me.
scripts.translation: 沒問題，給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Well, well!
You know! Have no regrets.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
哎呀，哎呀！
你看，別後悔哦。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
but they are still good.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
這些是我年輕時穿過的，
但質量依然很好。

scripts.text: Second-hand stuff, huh?
scripts.translation: 二手貨啊？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Give them back to me.
How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
還給我。
我送你我的東西，你居然這樣反應？

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
I...
I can't take back what I already gave away.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
我...
我已經送出去的東西，收不回來了。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Now I am going to say greetings again.
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
現在我要再次向你致意了。

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
願超級初心者{0}受到超級初心者守護者的祝福！

scripts.text:
[Nodor]
Don't forget that you are a Novice.
Be a Novice always!
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!
scripts.translation:
[諾多爾]
別忘了，你是初心者。
永遠保持初心吧！
人生的目標就是過得舒心又正常！

scripts.text:
[Fishing Novice]
Hush!
Please be quiet because you'll
scare all the fish away.
scripts.translation:
[釣魚新手]
噓！
請安靜一點，
不然會把魚都嚇跑的。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊~~我沒有錢買吃的。
我餓了，但不知道哥哥什麼時候回來...

scripts.text: Hey, are you... Mr. Nudor?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你是...努多爾先生嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eeeeeh?! Who wants to know?
Do I know you?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哎~~？誰想知道啊？
我認識你嗎？

scripts.text: - You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -
scripts.translation: - 向努多爾解釋你來看他的原因。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊哈！你是來替我哥哥給我零花錢的~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哇哇哇~~他給了你多少？

scripts.text:
- Nudor stares with twinkling -
- eyes, holding out his hands. -
- How much do you want to give? -
scripts.translation:
- 努多爾眨巴著眼睛，
- 伸出手等著。 -
- 你想給他多少？ -

scripts.text: I have no money
scripts.translation: 我沒有錢

scripts.text: Give 100,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 給100,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 300,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 給300,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Give 1,000,000 Zeny
Give all the money you have
scripts.translation: 把我所有的錢都給你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- crying -
I hate Nodor --- !
I hate you too --- !
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
- 哭泣 -
我討厭諾多爾---！
我也討厭你---！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
真好~~他給了你{0} Zeny？真不少呢！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
噢...天哪，你真的要把所有的Zeny都給我嗎？真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
What? But where is {0} Zeny?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
什麼？但是{0} Zeny在哪裡？

scripts.text: No, not really...
scripts.translation: 不，不太行...

scripts.text: Give it all
scripts.translation: 全部給你

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Pshaw! How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
嘁！真是讓人失望！

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
誒？可是你沒錢啊。你好窮啊，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
I can't believe it...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
哇~！！{0} Zeny！幫了大忙呢~嘿嘿~
真不敢相信...

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Did you know? You're really handsome~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
你知道嗎？你真的好帥~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
我要告訴你，你真的...真的~漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
- You feel like you're being -
- tricked, so go back to Nodor. -
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
- 感覺被耍了，所以去找諾多爾。 -

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
不敢相信我哥給我寄了錢...我好喜歡~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ooooops!
{0}, hush --- !!

[Nudor]
Don't tell Nodor about this~~
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
別告訴諾多爾這件事~~

scripts.text:
[Nudor]
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
scripts.translation:
[努多爾]
啊~~我沒有錢買吃的。
我餓了，但不知道哥哥什麼時候回來...
